paragraphs.source_en: Of Ieyasu's nine sons, only five were still alive: Hidetada, Tadateru, Yoshinao, Yorinobu, and Yorifusa.

units.source_en: Of Ieyasu's nine sons, only five were still alive: Hidetada, Tadateru, Yoshinao, Yorinobu, and Yorifusa.
units.source_zh: 家康九个儿子，存世只秀忠、忠辉、义直、赖宣和赖房五人。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康九个儿子，存世只秀忠、忠辉、义直、赖宣和赖房五人。

paragraphs.source_en: Even now, Ieyasu had made no mention of Tadateru. Lady Chaa sat in the lowest place, her head bowed and her grief forcibly suppressed. But who had any thought to spare for her sorrow? Ieyasu sank once more into a heavy, muddled sleep, uttering low moans. Hidetada then urged his three brothers to leave.

units.source_en: Even now, Ieyasu had made no mention of Tadateru.
units.source_zh: 家康到如今也未提起忠辉。

units.source_en: Lady Chaa sat in the lowest place, her head bowed and her grief forcibly suppressed.
units.source_zh: 茶阿局坐在末席，低头不语，强忍悲伤。

units.source_en: But who had any thought to spare for her sorrow?
units.source_zh: 但，谁人会顾得上她的悲伤？

units.source_en: Ieyasu sank once more into a heavy, muddled sleep, uttering low moans.
units.source_zh: 家康又昏昏沉沉睡了过去，发出低低的呻吟。

units.source_en: Hidetada then urged his three brothers to leave.
units.source_zh: 秀忠遂催促着三个兄弟离去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康到如今也未提起忠辉。茶阿局坐在末席，低头不语，强忍悲伤。但，谁人会顾得上她的悲伤？家康又昏昏沉沉睡了过去，发出低低的呻吟。秀忠遂催促着三个兄弟离去。

paragraphs.source_en: Although Ieyasu had shown some improvement, no one dared hope that he would fully recover. His allotted span was nearing its end; this was likely no more than a temporary rally.

units.source_en: Although Ieyasu had shown some improvement, no one dared hope that he would fully recover.
units.source_zh: 虽说家康有所恢复，但是谁也不敢期待他能完全康复。

units.source_en: His allotted span was nearing its end; this was likely no more than a temporary rally.
units.source_zh: 天寿将终，这只怕是暂时的好转。

paragraphs.source_zh: 虽说家康有所恢复，但是谁也不敢期待他能完全康复。天寿将终，这只怕是暂时的好转。

paragraphs.source_en: “I shall remain in Sunpu for the time being and attend to affairs of government. See that you remain in contact with Edo, and do not let your vigilance lapse.” After giving these instructions to Doi Toshikatsu and Honda Masazumi, Hidetada took up residence in Sunpu Castle from the second day of the second month.

units.source_en: “I shall remain in Sunpu for the time being and attend to affairs of government.
units.source_zh: “我会暂时留在骏府处理政务。

units.source_en: See that you remain in contact with Edo, and do not let your vigilance lapse.”
units.source_zh: 你们注意和江户联络，不可疏忽。”

units.source_en: After giving these instructions to Doi Toshikatsu and Honda Masazumi, Hidetada took up residence in Sunpu Castle from the second day of the second month.
units.source_zh: 秀忠这般吩咐过土井利胜和本多正纯之后，从二月初二起便住在骏府城。

paragraphs.source_zh: “我会暂时留在骏府处理政务。你们注意和江户联络，不可疏忽。”秀忠这般吩咐过土井利胜和本多正纯之后，从二月初二起便住在骏府城。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu's condition alternately improved and worsened: at times phlegm obstructed his breathing, at others his pulse became erratic, and an air of tension hung over Sunpu Castle.

units.source_en: Ieyasu's condition alternately improved and worsened: at times phlegm obstructed his breathing, at others his pulse became erratic, and an air of tension hung over Sunpu Castle.
units.source_zh: 家康的病情时好时坏，时而痰液瘀堵，时而脉搏紊乱，骏府城笼罩着紧张之气。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康的病情时好时坏，时而痰液瘀堵，时而脉搏紊乱，骏府城笼罩着紧张之气。

paragraphs.source_en: Once the second month began, messengers inquiring after his health also arrived one after another from Kyoto, sent by the retired emperor's consort Lady Konoe, the Nyoin, imperial princes, court nobles, and various shrines and temples.

units.source_en: Once the second month began, messengers inquiring after his health also arrived one after another from Kyoto, sent by the retired emperor's consort Lady Konoe, the Nyoin, imperial princes, court nobles, and various shrines and temples.
units.source_zh: 进入二月之后，京都也陆续派来探病的使者，有上皇的妃子近卫氏、女院、亲王、公卿，还有各神社寺院派来的人。

paragraphs.source_zh: 进入二月之后，京都也陆续派来探病的使者，有上皇的妃子近卫氏、女院、亲王、公卿，还有各神社寺院派来的人。

paragraphs.source_en: Only after Ieyasu fell gravely ill did people realize that he was an indispensable pillar of the realm.

units.source_en: Only after Ieyasu fell gravely ill did people realize that he was an indispensable pillar of the realm.
units.source_zh: 家康病重之后，众人才发现，对于天下，他乃是不可或缺之柱石。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康病重之后，众人才发现，对于天下，他乃是不可或缺之柱石。

paragraphs.source_en: The daimyo arrived in Sunpu one after another. Date Masamune, upon whom all eyes were fixed, also left Sendai on the tenth, passed through Edo without stopping, and continued straight to Sunpu. By the time he reached Sunpu, it was already the twenty-third day of the second month.

units.source_en: The daimyo arrived in Sunpu one after another.
units.source_zh: 诸大名陆陆续续来到骏府。

units.source_en: Date Masamune, upon whom all eyes were fixed, also left Sendai on the tenth, passed through Edo without stopping, and continued straight to Sunpu.
units.source_zh: 众人瞩目的伊达政宗也于初十从仙台起身，过江户而不停，一路来到骏府。

units.source_en: By the time he reached Sunpu, it was already the twenty-third day of the second month.
units.source_zh: 当他到达骏府，已是二月二十三。

paragraphs.source_zh: 诸大名陆陆续续来到骏府。众人瞩目的伊达政宗也于初十从仙台起身，过江户而不停，一路来到骏府。当他到达骏府，已是二月二十三。

paragraphs.source_en: On the third day after Hidetada arrived in Sunpu, Ieyasu's condition improved slightly, and he could even sit up in bed from time to time. Yet on the morning of the twenty-second, the day before Date Masamune reached Edo, he suddenly collapsed again and could no longer rise from his bed.

units.source_en: On the third day after Hidetada arrived in Sunpu, Ieyasu's condition improved slightly, and he could even sit up in bed from time to time.
units.source_zh: 家康的病情在秀忠抵骏府第三日略有好转，甚至偶尔能从病榻上坐起。

units.source_en: Yet on the morning of the twenty-second, the day before Date Masamune reached Edo, he suddenly collapsed again and could no longer rise from his bed.
units.source_zh: 伊达政宗抵江户的前一天，即二十二晨，他却突然再次昏倒，卧床不起。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康的病情在秀忠抵骏府第三日略有好转，甚至偶尔能从病榻上坐起。伊达政宗抵江户的前一天，即二十二晨，他却突然再次昏倒，卧床不起。

paragraphs.source_en: When word came that Masamune intended to pay a sickbed visit and had already reached Sunpu, Hidetada immediately sensed a murderous menace.

units.source_en: When word came that Masamune intended to pay a sickbed visit and had already reached Sunpu, Hidetada immediately sensed a murderous menace.
units.source_zh: 当接到政宗要来探病，并业已抵达骏府的消息，秀忠顿觉一股杀气。

paragraphs.source_zh: 当接到政宗要来探病，并业已抵达骏府的消息，秀忠顿觉一股杀气。

paragraphs.source_en: “The Great Lord is gravely ill. Under no circumstances is he to be admitted to the sickroom.”

units.source_en: “The Great Lord is gravely ill. Under no circumstances is he to be admitted to the sickroom.”
units.source_zh: “大御所病重，万万不可把他带至病室。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “大御所病重，万万不可把他带至病室。”

paragraphs.source_en: “How can we greet such an ambitious man with smiles?”

units.source_en: “How can we greet such an ambitious man with smiles?”
units.source_zh: “野心勃勃之徒，怎能对他笑脸相迎？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “野心勃勃之徒，怎能对他笑脸相迎？”

paragraphs.source_en: Aoyama Tadatoshi bore the deepest resentment toward Masamune, followed by Honda Masazumi. Precisely because everyone knew that Ieyasu wished to suppress Masamune's rebellious inclinations, Date's request placed them in a most difficult position. But Date Masamune was exceedingly obstinate, declaring that if he could not see Lord Ieyasu, he must be granted an immediate audience with the shogun.

units.source_en: Aoyama Tadatoshi bore the deepest resentment toward Masamune, followed by Honda Masazumi.
units.source_zh: 青山忠俊对政宗的怨恨尤甚，其次为本多正纯。

units.source_en: Precisely because everyone knew that Ieyasu wished to suppress Masamune's rebellious inclinations, Date's request placed them in a most difficult position.

ja.t: えようとしていることを

units.source_zh: 正因为众人清楚，家康欲压制政宗叛心，伊达之请才令人大为棘手。

units.source_en: But Date Masamune was exceedingly obstinate, declaring that if he could not see Lord Ieyasu, he must be granted an immediate audience with the shogun.
units.source_zh: 但伊达政宗十分固执，声称若不能见到家康公，亦当即刻见将军。

paragraphs.source_zh: 青山忠俊对政宗的怨恨尤甚，其次为本多正纯。正因为众人清楚，家康欲压制政宗叛心，伊达之请才令人大为棘手。但伊达政宗十分固执，声称若不能见到家康公，亦当即刻见将军。

paragraphs.source_en: “Upon hearing of the Great Lord's illness, I hastened here from Sendai night and day, fearing that if I failed to see him one last time, I would regret it for the rest of my life. The Great Lord surely knows the heart of Date Masamune, and I am certain he will receive me warmly. I wish only to offer a single greeting: ‘Great Lord, Masamune has come.’”

units.source_en: “Upon hearing of the Great Lord's illness, I hastened here from Sendai night and day, fearing that if I failed to see him one last time, I would regret it for the rest of my life.

units.source_en: The Great Lord surely knows the heart of Date Masamune, and I am certain he will receive me warmly.
units.source_zh: 伊达政宗之心，大御所必知，他定会盛情相迎。

units.source_zh: 在下只想去问候一声：大御所，政宗来了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “惊闻大御所染病，在下日夜兼程从仙台赶来，只怕见不到大御所最后一面而后悔终生。伊达政宗之心，大御所必知，他定会盛情相迎。在下只想去问候一声：大御所，政宗来了。”

paragraphs.source_en: Doi Toshikatsu finally decided to announce Date Masamune's arrival. Yet Masamune was, after all, one of the rare formidable schemers of the age, so Toshikatsu stationed Todo Takatora and Yagyu Munenori beside Ieyasu and intended to admit Masamune only after making him remove both his long and short swords. But before entering, Masamune voluntarily removed his swords, handed them to Matsudaira Katsutaka, and only then went inside.

units.source_en: Doi Toshikatsu finally decided to announce Date Masamune's arrival.
units.source_zh: 土井利胜最终决定为伊达政宗通报。

units.source_en: Yet Masamune was, after all, one of the rare formidable schemers of the age, so Toshikatsu stationed Todo Takatora and Yagyu Munenori beside Ieyasu and intended to admit Masamune only after making him remove both his long and short swords.
units.source_zh: 但此人毕竟为当代少有的枭雄，利胜让藤堂高虎和柳生宗矩守护在家康一旁，并打算令政宗摘下身上长短刀，才放其入房。

units.source_en: But before entering, Masamune voluntarily removed his swords, handed them to Matsudaira Katsutaka, and only then went inside.

paragraphs.source_en: When Doi Toshikatsu announced him, Ieyasu seemed to understand, yet at the same time appeared confused.

paragraphs.source_en: The shogun's retainers meant merely to bring Masamune in, let him take one look and make his obeisance, and then have done with it. That way, he would know that Ieyasu was by no means feigning illness and that they had no intention whatsoever of concealing news of the Great Lord's death. If he dared show the slightest discourtesy, they would haul him before the shogun and teach him a lesson.

Just as Masamune had said, perhaps the sunlight that shone upon all the world had truly touched him, and compassion had restored him to his humanity.
